intro: Austria is a wealthy country with strong industry, a big tourism sector and electricity that comes mostly from renewable sources.

chapters.title: Industry and brands
text: Austrian factories make machinery, steel and car parts; Magna Steyr in Graz even builds complete cars for other brands. Red Bull and Swarovski crystal are Austrian companies.

chapters.title: Tourism and energy
text: Ski resorts, lakes and Vienna make tourism a major industry. Rivers and mountains provide hydropower, and most of Austria's electricity comes from renewable sources. Austria uses the euro.
